labeller: blind AI review (Claude), title + one photo + every CPSC recall since 1973 and CPSC's safety warnings

missed.title: Baby & Joy Gray Baby Hammock For Crib
missed.why: Baby hammock that hangs in a crib for sleep; CPSC treats infant hammocks for sleep as banned inclined sleepers (see CaTeam recall 23237). Brand isn't recalled.

missed.title: Beautiful pack and play with bassinette, changing cradle, music and vi 1
missed.why: Photo shows 'Kolcraft Travelin' Tot' on the top rail, and the title mentions a bassinet, changer and vibration; recall 09265 names the Travelin' Tot line (by model number prefixes), including units with a bassinet, changer and vibration.

missed.title: Portable Safe Soft Baby Sleeper/Bassinet
missed.why: Unbranded fold-out padded portable sleeper with two foam side positioner wedges in the photo.

missed.title: Happiness Baby Safety Baby Cradle Free Hanging Hammock Portable Pink BC1071
missed.why: Happiness Baby free-hanging fabric sling cradle (package photo); CPSC treats baby hammock sleepers as inclined sleep products (see the CaTeam recall 23237), but no recall names this brand.

falseAlarms.title: Wanted OLD Motorcycles CASH PAID Pre-1980 Harley Honda Kawasaki BMW 1
falseAlarms.why: Wanted ad for old motorcycles, unrelated.

falseAlarms.title: RH Baby & Child Callum Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed - Sandwashed Grey 1
falseAlarms.why: RH Callum twin bunk bed; RH's Callum recall (19739) covers only Callum canopy beds, not bunk beds.

falseAlarms.title: Baby Bjorn Pack N Play Travel Light Portable Crib With Carrying Case
falseAlarms.why: BabyBjorn Travel Crib Light in carry bag; BabyBjorn recalls cover carriers, bouncers and spoons only.

falseAlarms.title: DockATot Deluxe+ Lounger Cover 0-8M White Green Tropical Banana Leaf Print
falseAlarms.why: Title and photo show only the DockATot Deluxe+ cover, not the lounger itself.

falseAlarms.title: Baby trends playpen is still available 1
falseAlarms.why: Photo shows a modern Baby Trend play yard (current logo); Baby Trend's play yard recalls cover only 1990s Home and Roam and Baby Express models.

falseAlarms.title: Carter's Newborn 0-3 mo Neutral Baby Bear Bunting Zip Sleeper Pajama Bundle Mix
falseAlarms.why: Carter's sleeper bundle, but the patterns shown (grey bunting, blue stripe with bunny feet, green) don't match the styles in Carter's zip sleeper recall 13167 or pajama recall 23048.

falseAlarms.title: Moses Basket Rocking Rocker Stand for Uppababy Vista, Bugaboo, Cruz etc Bassinet
falseAlarms.why: Jolly Jumper rocking basket stand (brand on the label); no recall for it.

falseAlarms.title: Vintage Infant Rocker Seat Cradle 1993 Fisher-Price 90s floral Sleep Rare Pastel
falseAlarms.why: 1993 Fisher-Price infant rocker seat with a handle on a rocking base; no Fisher-Price recall covers a 1993 rocker seat, and rockers are not one of the types.

falseAlarms.title: Lullaby Earth Breathe Safe Air Breathable Crib Mattress Pad, Mattress Cover
falseAlarms.why: Boxed Lullaby Earth breathable crib mattress cover; no recall.

falseAlarms.title: 4moms Breeze Plus Playard 1
falseAlarms.why: 4moms Breeze Plus play yard with a flat changer; 4moms recall 13115 covers only Breeze cotton jersey sheets, which are not shown.

falseAlarms.why: Modern Baby Trend play yard (logo on photo); Baby Trend's play yard recalls cover only the 1990s Home and Roam and Baby Express models.

falseAlarms.why: Stokke Sleepi V2 oval mattress; the 2007 Sleepi mattress recall (07286) covers only the original Sleepi crib models 660xxx/652xxx, not V2.
